meta.name: cold-start-problem
meta.description: Start and scale networked products using Andrew Chen's "The Cold Start Problem" framework for network effects. Use when the user mentions "network effects", "chicken and egg", "cold start", "two-sided marketplace", "atomic network", "hard side", "liquidity", "critical mass", "invite-only launch", "how do I get my first users", or "the marketplace has no buyers or sellers". Also trigger when launching a marketplace, social, or collaboration product that is worthless without other users, deciding launch sequencing and seeding tactics, or diagnosing stalled network growth at scale. Covers the five stages: cold start, tipping point, escape velocity, hitting the ceiling, and the moat. For word-of-mouth virality, see contagious. For habit-driven retention, see hooked-ux.

copy.tagline: 用冷启动框架启动网络型产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在启动一个需要用户网络才能运转的产品。
copy.tagline_en: Launch networked products using the Cold Start Problem framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are launching a product that needs a user network to work.

howto.what: Claude 会使用 Andrew Chen 的「冷启动问题」框架，帮你分析网络效应产品（如市场、社交应用）的启动和增长策略，包括识别原子网络、解决硬边、设计邀请机制等，并给出 0-10 分的评分和改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“网络效应”、“冷启动”、“双边市场”、“原子网络”、“流动性”等关键词，或询问如何获取第一批用户、如何启动市场/社交/协作产品时触发。

say.text: 我的社交应用如何获取第一批用户？
say.note: Claude 会使用冷启动框架分析你的原子网络和硬边策略。

say.text: 帮我评估这个双边市场的启动计划，给出评分。
say.note: Claude 会按框架评分并列出改进项。

say.text: 如何设计邀请机制来启动我的平台？
say.note: Claude 会解释邀请制的作用并提供具体建议。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Andrew Chen's "The Cold Start Problem" framework to help you analyze and plan the launch and growth of networked products (e.g., marketplaces, social apps). It identifies atomic networks, solves the hard side, designs invite mechanics, and scores your plan 0-10 with improvement steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "network effects", "cold start", "two-sided marketplace", "atomic network", "liquidity", or ask about getting first users, launching a marketplace/social/collaboration product.

say_en.text: How do I get my first users for my social app?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes your atomic network and hard side strategy.

say_en.text: Evaluate this marketplace launch plan and give a score.
How to design an invite-only launch for my platform?
say_en.note: Claude explains invite mechanics and gives advice.
